sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I4, 
which must be performed every four years as indicated by Y4 
in the title block.

ال 
تتمثل الوظيفة في الحفاظ على سرعة الوحدة عند 100 دورة في الدقيقة أثناء اتصال الوحدة بالإنترنت 
والتحكم في فتح بوابة الويكيت وموضع العداء.

The first draft 
initiated by eng. Mohamed Al-Lethy Ahmed, tested by eng. Abdel Gawad Yousef 
Mohamed, 
accepted by general director eng. Atty Sefin Rezq Alla, approved by eng. 
Mohamed Abdel-Baset Mohamed Rekaby; head sector of Aswan Dam (1&2) power 
stations and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and 
quality control general director and MPIS coordinator.
احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح عمل، والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة.
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير تحيط بمنطقة العمل.

Wear your safety equipment as helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc
Unit out of service.

مجموعة أدوات الصيانة الكاملة
Wrenches, Indicators, Voltmeter.
العمل المراد تنفيذه

Change filters, inspect 
and clean flow regulators and pressure regulators.

Inspect, disassemble, 
clean, assemble and calibrate the pilot valve bushing and plunger in the 
distributing valve and in the transducer assembly.

Check, disassemble, clean, 
assemble the gate limit valve plunger and the pilot servomotor.

Ensure that there is no 
friction through the full stroke.

Check and calibrate the 
gate position and gate limit indication.

Adjust for cable stretch 
if necessary.

افحص الزيت 
 رئيس.

Repair the 
 cavitations of blades.
Check the clearance of blades.
Check the clearance between the gates.
Empty, clean the ACC., and change the oil.
Change the stuff of the oil head.
